fields.name: Name
fields.rememberMe: Keep me logged in on this device for 30 days

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match. Retype the confirmation.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the six digits from your authenticator app.
errors.backupCodeInvalid: Enter a recovery code exactly as it was issued.
errors.tokenMissing: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

outcomes.wrongCredentials: Email or password is wrong. Check both and try again, or reset your password.
outcomes.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before logging in. We can send the link again.
outcomes.suspended: This account is suspended. Runs already recorded are kept; ask your organization owner to restore access.
outcomes.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
outcomes.alreadyRegistered: That email is already registered. Log in instead, or reset your password.
outcomes.codeWrong: That code is wrong. Check your authenticator app and try again.
outcomes.linkExpired: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
outcomes.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute.
outcomes.unknown: That did not work. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Mission Control for the agents your team runs.
login.haveInvite: Have an invitation? Open the link in its email.

signup.title: Govern the agents you already run.
signup.lead: Wrap Claude Code, Codex CLI, Stella or an SDK agent. Every organization gets its first 1,000 runs a month free, with every governance feature on.
signup.terms: By creating an account you agree to the Oxagen terms and privacy notice. Oxagen never stores your model provider keys in plain text, and never shows them again once saved.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.lead: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it on this device to finish creating your account.
verify.leadNoEmail: We sent a verification link to the address you signed up with. Open it on this device to finish creating your account.
verify.expired: That verification link is invalid or has expired. Send a new one below.
verify.resent: If an account for that address is waiting to be verified, a new link is on its way. The old one no longer works.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.lead: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.leadBackup: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor. Each code works once.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: We will email a link that is good for 60 minutes.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. The link is good for 60 minutes and works once. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive in a few minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.lead: Setting a new password logs out every other device.
reset.doneBody: Every other device was logged out. Log in with your new password.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links last 60 minutes and work once. Request a new one and it arrives in under a minute.

invite.title: Join {org} on Oxagen
invite.declined: Invitation declined. {org} has been told; nothing else changed.
invite.signInLead: Log in or create an account as {email} to accept.
invite.wrongAccountTitle: This invitation is for a different account
invite.wrongAccountBody: It was sent to {invited}. You are logged in as {current}. Log out and back in as the invited address, or ask for a new invitation.
invite.notFoundTitle: This invitation link does not work
invite.notFoundBody: The link is incomplete, or the invitation was withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

closed.accepted: This invitation has already been accepted. Log in instead.
closed.declined: This invitation was declined. Ask for a new one if that was a mistake.
closed.revoked: This invitation was withdrawn by the organization.
closed.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

invite.failed: The invitation could not be accepted. Try again, and ask for a new invitation if it keeps failing.
invite.unavailable: Accepting invitations is not available in fixture mode.

cli.title: Authorize the Oxagen CLI
cli.lead: {label} is asking for access to one of your workspaces.
cli.grantKeys: Create and manage API keys in the selected workspace
cli.grantActs: Act on your behalf for CLI commands
cli.invalidBody: Run the CLI login command again to get a new link.

invalid.redirectUri: redirect_uri must be an HTTP loopback address (127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1) with an explicit port.
invalid.codeChallenge: code_challenge must be a 43-character base64url SHA-256 value.

cli.noScopeBody: Your account is not a member of any workspace yet. Create an organization first, then run the CLI login again.

errors.notMember: You are not a member of this workspace.
errors.notPermitted: Authorizing the CLI needs permission to create API keys. Ask an organization owner or admin.
errors.fixture: Fixture mode does not mint CLI authorization codes.
errors.failed: The CLI could not be authorized. Run the login command again.
